title: Driven to the Edge
speaker: Pastor Erica Roth
description: Pastor Erica Roth delivered a thought-provoking sermon titled "Driven to the Edge," focusing on the powerful story from Luke 4:21-30. As we gathered on February 2nd, we explored the complexities of Jesus' journey and the challenges he faced in his own hometown. The message resonated deeply, inviting us to reflect on our own experiences of being "driven to the edge" and how we can find strength and purpose in those moments.
